With no limit the update never stops to wait, but in 869.4–869.65 MHz the rules allow 10% time on air an hour. Use it only when you know it is allowed.

The repeater\'s battery is below 3.7 V. The update is paused and everything received is kept for 30 minutes: charge it (or connect power) and press "Continue".
Note: in the last 20 seconds or so the repeater copies the new firmware over the old one. If the power goes off then, someone has to go there.
WARNING
If the power goes off, someone has to go there.

The new firmware does not fit next to the old one on this repeater, so it is written over it. The risky part is the last 20 seconds or so, while the repeater copies: a power cut then leaves it with no firmware, fixed only on site (USB or Bluetooth).
